title: The Bounty Autopsy: why did nobody claim it?
description:
Every board has bounties nobody claims. This one pays for the autopsy, not the complaint.

Pick ONE open Poidh bounty with zero claims (any chain). In one claim:
1. Link the bounty and show the claim count is zero at the time you post (screenshot or exact page text).
2. Quote the reward, deadline and eligibility from the bounty itself.
3. Diagnose the most likely reason nobody claimed it. Use the bounty text: price, unclear acceptance test, hidden gate, impossible scope, wrong audience, physical/geographic constraint, or something else specific.
4. Propose one concrete fix the issuer could make in under 10 minutes.
5. State what evidence would prove the fix worked.

No generic "it needs more marketing". The diagnosis must point to the bounty's own text and compare it with one comparable bounty that did get claims. The fix must be specific enough to implement.

Winner: the most useful, checkable autopsy. 0.001 ETH. One claim per person. I will pick within 7 days of the deadline. The point is a public diagnostic library for Poidh issuers, not a complaint thread.

winningClaim.title: Autopsy: #1528 is a global photo ask with a local travel cost
winningClaim.description:
Bounty: https://poidh.xyz/base/bounty/1528 — “Find a hand-painted sign that's older than you”, 0.002 ETH, 0 claims at 2026-11-06 15:10 UTC. Deadline: 30 days after funding.

Exact ask: a photo of the sign in place, the business's GBP URL, and evidence the sign is older than the entrant. That is a clear evidence bar, but the bounty never names a city, region, or country. A stranger cannot tell whether a qualifying sign is reachable, and $4 does not cover a trip. Compare #1522 “take a cool pic” — 6 claims, because any phone and any place qualifies. #1528 is not underpaid for a local person; it is unpriced for a global audience.

Fix (under 10 minutes): add “any sign in <city/region>” or explicitly allow a sign the entrant can reach on foot; add one example photo and say the GBP URL can be the business's public listing. Success test: at least 3 claims that name a city, or a claim volume above zero within 7 days. The card shows the exact page state.
